A deep Norwegian-style fjord valley seen from a high rocky ledge. In the foreground, a jagged grey crag with pale lichen patches juts out. Below, a narrow blue-green lake winds between steep, shadowed mountainsides. The slopes are covered in dense dark-green forest and scrub, with bare rock and patches of snow near the distant peaks. Above, a bright blue sky holds thin, wispy white clouds, with soft haze softening the far ridges.
